description: V0.6c compare-30 recorded-decision replay, entry stable: every completed live LLM run's recorded decisions (docs/benchmark/v06c-dev/compare-30/) submitted again through the protocol by the agent's replay mode, without any model, beside the no-op baseline. Deterministic: a rerun gives the same files. Run from the repository root.
seedPlan: The seeds of docs/benchmark/v06c-dev/compare-30.json, so that the recorded decisions belong to the runs.

external.description: the LLM agent (llm-agent 2) in replay mode: qwen36-35b-a3b's recorded decisions from compare-30, entry stable, one recording per seed; the memory and prompt are rebuilt and checked against their recorded SHA-256; no model is called
